title: Feature: Design-system starter
hero: A neutral, full starter design system that design-system-setup writes on init, filled from the project's own styles when the owner agrees.
lede: The shipped template has 4 example rules, 2 components and 9 tokens, so a new project starts from a blank page. The owner chose a full, project-neutral starter written from scratch, close in scope to a mature design system the owner already uses, without its product rules.
